stem:
The set designer for a play painted some background scenery on a large piece of plywood. He used a 13-foot-long pole to hold the piece of plywood upright, as shown in the diagram below.

What is h, the total height in feet of the piece of plywood?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: Diagram of a right triangle formed by the plywood, the pole, and the ground. The pole is labeled 13 ft, the base is labeled 5 ft, the height above the ground to the top of the plywood is labeled h plus a 2 ft segment above it.
